description: A replay of a change from atelier's history (harness/replay.py): atelier-59vp's change (b38c536b), which enforces the mission and epic hierarchy rules in commands, lint and bundles. The defect found after merge (defects.md row 11, atelier-4xyr): a bundle may declare advances only on a mission, while issue link accepts it from either endpoint. The reviewer of atelier-237o, in review, started with the task line `submit` prints, in a confined run (harness/confine.py) that cannot read the fix. Pass: a round-1 review by another thread, with a fix-now finding the judge reads as naming the known defect. Reported: whether the code supports each other fix-now finding. Needs EVAL_ATELIER and this repository's history.
